# HANNCREST — Full Text Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive technical specification, application documentation, privacy architecture, pricing models, comparison tables, and FAQ index for HANNCREST macOS applications.

## 1. About HANNCREST
- **Studio Name**: HANNCREST
- **Website**: https://www.hanncrest.com/
- **Trust & Verification**: https://www.hanncrest.com/#trust
- **Publisher Email**: contact@hanncrest.com
- **Target Operating System**: macOS 13.0 Ventura (Vitals), macOS 14.0 Sonoma & macOS 15.0 Sequoia and later (all apps).
- **Architectures Supported**: Universal binaries for Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4) and Intel x86_64. (WhisperType is optimized specifically for Apple Silicon Neural Engine).
- **Tech Stack**: 100% native Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit, Metal, Apple MLX, CoreML, and Apple Neural Engine. Zero Electron, zero Chromium, zero web wrappers.

### The Four Non-Negotiable Pillars
1. **Truly Native**: Built strictly in native Swift and SwiftUI. Instant startup, minimal memory footprints (<45 MB RAM idle), and zero unnecessary battery drain.
2. **Privacy Absolute & Verifiable (0 KB Sent)**: Zero telemetry, zero analytics trackers, zero external logging. Every claim of 0 KB network egress is independently verifiable using packet inspection tools such as Little Snitch, LuLu, or Wireshark.
3. **Local-First In-RAM Silicon Execution**: System metrics, disk indexing, local LLM inference, and speech recognition occur strictly on local CPU/GPU/Neural Engine silicon within RAM.
4. **Honest One-Time Pricing**: Generous free tiers with perpetual one-time purchase licenses. No subscriptions, recurring charges, or surprise renewals. Buy once, own forever.

## 4. In-Depth Product Specifications

### App 1: Vitals
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/vitals/
- **Headline**: Know exactly what your Mac is doing.
- **Category**: System Monitor & Hardware Diagnostics Utility.
- **Operating System**: macOS 13.0 Ventura or later (macOS 14 Sonoma & macOS 15 Sequoia fully supported). Universal binary for Apple Silicon (M1–M4) and Intel.
- **Pricing**: Free tier forever for core monitoring. Vitals Pro is a one-time purchase of $14.99 USD following a 14-day full-featured free trial. No subscriptions.

#### Free vs. Pro Comparison
| Feature | Vitals Free | Vitals Pro ($14.99 once) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Real-time CPU & GPU load | Basic overall percentage | Full per-core breakdown & Apple Silicon frequencies |
| Unified Memory & pressure | Used / Free RAM gauge | Detailed wired/compressed memory & leak tracking |
| Storage & S.M.A.R.T. health | Basic free disk space | Full TBW wear life & read/write endurance metrics |
| Thermals & fan speeds | Basic temperature gauge | Sensor-level thermals & manual fan RPM curves |
| Local LLM token tracker | Not included | Real-time tokens/sec, VRAM tracking & one-tap reclaim |
| Battery Vampire Detector | Not included | Tame (throttle), Freeze (SIGSTOP), and Force-Quit |
| Sleep Drain Report | Not included | Exact % lost asleep + sleep-assertion culprit logging |
| Menu-bar customization | Standard compact icon | Fully customizable multi-metric gauges & graph widgets |
| Historical logging | 24-hour log | 30-day time-series history with export |

#### What Vitals Does NOT Do
1. **No Telemetry**: Zero analytics SDKs (no Mixpanel, Google Analytics, Firebase, or Datadog).
2. **No User Accounts**: No registration, no login, no passwords.
3. **No Cloud Processing**: All calculations run locally in RAM via native macOS sysctl and IOKit APIs.
4. **Verified 0 KB Egress**: Zero network sockets opened for telemetry. Tested with Little Snitch.

#### Hardware Architecture (Apple Silicon vs. Intel)
- **Apple Silicon (M1–M4)**: Reports Unified Memory architecture, Neural Engine activity, separate efficiency/performance core clusters, and local LLM VRAM allocations.
- **Intel Macs**: Reports discrete/integrated GPU split, traditional dual-channel DDR RAM, and Intel CPU package thermals.

---

### App 2: Breeze
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/breeze/
- **Headline**: Clean your Mac without blindly deleting things.
- **Category**: Storage Optimization & Maintenance Utility.
- **Operating System**: macOS 14.0 Sonoma or later. Universal binary for Apple Silicon & Intel.
- **Pricing**: Free tier includes Smart Scan, Health Score, and Storage Map. Breeze Pro is a one-time purchase of $24.99 USD with lifetime access.

#### Safety & Review Workflow
Breeze operates on a strict **safety-first philosophy**:
1. **Review Before Deletion**: Nothing is deleted without interactive review. Every file, bundle, and cache entry is clearly presented with its file path and size.
2. **Move-to-Trash Safety Net**: All user-approved cleanups move files to the macOS Trash (`~/.Trash`) rather than performing immediate destructive unlinks. If a file was removed by mistake, it can be restored with ⌘Z or Put Back from the Trash.
3. **SIP Compliance**: Breeze strictly respects System Integrity Protection (SIP) and never touches root system files, system framework caches, or protected OS volumes.

#### Real-World Scan Snapshot
A typical developer Mac scan recovers **34.2 GB of safe recoverable space** from:
- Xcode DerivedData: ~14.8 GB
- Obsolete iOS Simulator Runtimes: ~8.2 GB
- Stale Browser & App Caches: ~4.5 GB
- Orphaned Application Preferences & Application Support files: ~2.1 GB
- NPM / CocoaPods / Gradle Caches: ~4.6 GB

#### Breeze vs. Legacy Mac Cleaners
| Metric / Feature | Breeze (Native) | Legacy Cleaners (CleanMyMac, MacKeeper) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Deletion Safety | Moves to macOS Trash (restorable) | Permanent instant unlinks |
| Inspection Control | Item-by-item granular review | Opaque "One-Click Clean" black box |
| Memory Footprint | < 45 MB RAM (Native SwiftUI) | > 350 MB RAM (Persistent background daemons) |
| Notification Policy | Completely silent; zero popups | Pushy upsell popups & fake virus warnings |
| Pricing Model | **$24.99 one-time** | **$39.95 / year subscription** |

---

### App 3: StealthShare
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/stealthshare/
- **Headline**: Never flash private Slack DMs, client emails, or API keys on a call again.
- **Category**: Privacy & Screen Sharing Utility.
- **Operating System**: macOS 14.0 Sonoma or later. Universal binary for Apple Silicon & Intel.
- **Pricing**: 14-day free trial with all features enabled. One-time purchase of $14.99 USD with lifetime updates. No subscriptions.

#### 5-Step Call Safeguard Workflow
1. **Step 01 · Detection**: StealthShare automatically detects Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Slack Huddles, or FaceTime connecting — or catches active camera/mic usage locally. Camera and microphone detection both work in the direct-download and Mac App Store builds (see boundaries below for how the sandboxed build reads the camera).
2. **Step 02 · Desktop Sanitization**: Messy desktop icons, sensitive file downloads, and personal widgets disappear instantly. A neutral, polished studio backdrop swaps in.
3. **Step 03 · Compositor Masking**: Designated apps (Slack, Messages, Mail, Terminal, Notes) are blurred in the screen-sharing stream, yet remain completely crisp and readable to the presenter.
4. **Step 04 · Live Guard**: Banners are silenced through macOS Focus. Accidental-Paste Guard intercepts high-entropy API tokens, passwords, and secrets before they land in a shared chat window (with a 4s override).
5. **Step 05 · Instant Restoration**: Hang up the call or tap ⌘⇧P. Custom wallpaper, widgets, and desktop icons return instantly, accompanied by a quiet log of held notifications.

#### What StealthShare CAN Hide vs. What It CANNOT Hide
- **What It CAN Hide (Guaranteed Protected)**:
  - Desktop file clutter, downloads, and stray screenshots.
  - Desktop widgets & active notification banners.
  - Designated app windows (Slack, Mail, Messages, Signal, Terminal).
  - Personal desktop wallpaper.
  - Accidental clipboard paste of high-entropy credentials.
- **What It CANNOT Hide (Hard Technical Boundaries)**:
  - Sensitive tabs inside an actively shared unmasked browser window (e.g. sharing Chrome with a confidential tab open).
  - macOS system menu bar & active Spotlight search bar (rendered globally by OS).
  - Physical room background or webcam video.
  - Remote meeting participants' client software behavior.
  - Mac App Store build: telling a live camera apart from a screen recording. The App Sandbox blocks reading camera-in-use status from the camera device (regardless of entitlements), so the sandboxed build reads the macOS recording indicator instead. That restores camera detection — including a browser-based meeting joined muted with only the camera on — but because macOS lights the same indicator for screen recording, starting a screen recording can also arm Privacy Mode in that build. The direct-download build reads the camera device directly and is not affected.

#### macOS Screen Recording Permission & Security Disclaimer
StealthShare requires the macOS Screen Recording entitlement strictly to compute window coordinates and render real-time blur overlays using Apple's native ScreenCaptureKit framework in RAM. **Zero video frames are ever recorded to disk or streamed across the network.** 0 KB network egress verified with Little Snitch.
*Disclaimer*: StealthShare is an operational safeguard designed to dramatically reduce accidental exposures during screen sharing. It is not an absolute cryptographic shield against user error.

---

### App 4: Aura
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/aura/
- **Headline**: Your private, on-device AI writing assistant.
- **Category**: Productivity & AI Writing Utility.
- **Operating System**: macOS 14.0 Sonoma or later. Apple Silicon (M1–M4) recommended for local MLX models.
- **Pricing**: One-time purchase of $24.99 USD with lifetime updates. No subscriptions.

#### 4-Step Inline Workflow
1. **Select**: Highlight any text in any macOS app (Mail, Notes, Slack, Chrome, VS Code).
2. **Press ⇧⌘P**: Aura reads the text via macOS Accessibility APIs directly into app memory.
3. **Stream in Place**: The floating HUD streams the rewritten text in real time using local MLX inference.
4. **Replace or Discard**: Tap Insert to replace the selection in-place, or tap Discard / esc to keep the original untouched.

#### Real-World Writing Transformations
- **Client Email (Professional)**:
  - *Draft*: "hey sorry for delay was busy with stuff but yeah we can ship wednesday"
  - *Aura (~0.8s)*: "Thank you for your patience. We have finalized the deliverables and are on schedule to ship this Wednesday."
- **Slack / Team Update (Make Concise)**:
  - *Draft*: "so basically the api is broken coz the auth token is null when users logout and it crashes the app"
  - *Aura (~0.9s)*: "Identified an issue where API calls fail on logout due to null auth tokens. Fix is underway."
- **Technical Documentation (Improve Clarity)**:
  - *Draft*: "this func takes a dict and iterates over keys to check if they exist in cache so it doesnt fetch again"
  - *Aura (~1.1s)*: "Evaluates incoming dictionary keys against local cache entries to prevent redundant network lookups."
- **Git Commit / Release Note (Conventional Commit)**:
  - *Draft*: "fix stuff in auth and clean up token caching"
  - *Aura (~0.7s)*: "fix(auth): invalidate cached session tokens upon logout"

#### 5 On-Device Models Supported
1. **Light (710 MB)**: Fast spelling and basic corrections. Smallest footprint.
2. **Balanced (1.82 GB - Default)**: Workhorse model. High quality ~1s proofreading for everyday writing.
3. **Writer (3.9 GB)**: Powered by Google Gemma 3n E4B. Tuned for elegant prose, tone shifts, and clarity.
4. **Best (4.29 GB)**: Contextual rewriting and summarization for 16 GB+ Macs.
5. **Expert (8.36 GB)**: Deep stylistic nuance for 24 GB+ Macs.

#### Aura vs. ChatGPT vs. Grammarly
| Feature / Tradeoff | Aura (Local) | ChatGPT / Claude | Grammarly |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Processing Location | **100% on your Mac (In-RAM MLX)** | Cloud servers (prompt logged) | Cloud servers (keystroke monitor) |
| Workflow Speed | **Instant in-place (Select + ⇧⌘P)** | Manual window switching & copy-paste | Inline browser/electron overlay |
| Offline Availability | **100% Offline (airplanes, travel)** | Requires internet connection | Requires internet connection |
| Price & License | **$24.99 one-time** | **$20/mo ($240/yr)** | **$12–$30/mo ($144–$360/yr)** |
| Best Suited For | Private daily writing, code, emails | Multi-turn reasoning & brainstorming | Passive consumer browser spellcheck |

### App 5: WhisperType
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/whispertype/
- **Headline**: Talk. Let go. Your words appear wherever you type.
- **Category**: Speech-to-Text Dictation & Accessibility Utility.
- **Operating System**: macOS 14.0 Sonoma or later. Built for Apple Silicon (M1–M4) utilizing the Apple Neural Engine.
- **Pricing**: One-time purchase of $19.99 USD with lifetime updates. No subscriptions.

#### Workflow & Messy-Speech Cleansing
Press **⌥Space** anywhere on macOS and speak naturally. WhisperType captures speech in memory, processes it via OpenAI Whisper models on the 16-core Apple Neural Engine, and types the transcription into the active text field, restoring the prior clipboard immediately afterward.
- Verbal clutter ("um", "uh", "like", stuttered false starts) is intelligently filtered.
- Natural pauses are converted into proper punctuation and capitalization.
- Technical, medical, and legal vocabulary is accurately preserved.

#### Apple Neural Engine Benchmarks
- **Transcription Speed**: 30 seconds of speech transcribed in **< 1.8 seconds** on Apple Silicon (M2/M3/M4).
- **Network Egress**: **0 KB** sent. 100% offline operation.
- **Thermals & CPU**: **0% CPU fan spinup**. Runs on dedicated Neural Engine silicon, keeping CPU idle and fans silent.
- **Multi-Language Support**: 99+ languages supported offline (Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Mandarin, etc.).

#### Lifetime Value: WhisperType vs. Cloud Dictation Subscriptions
| Feature / Cost | WhisperType | Cloud Dictation (Superwhisper / Otter / Dragon) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Year 1 Cost | **$19.99 one-time** | $120.00 – $240.00 / year |
| 3-Year Total Cost | **$19.99 total** | **$360.00 – $720.00 total** |
| 3-Year Savings | **$340.00 – $700.00 saved** | $0 (Recurring subscription liability) |
| Voice Data Privacy | **In-RAM on your Mac only (0 KB egress)** | Uploaded and stored on third-party cloud servers |
| Offline Dictation | **100% Offline (airplanes, Wi-Fi deadzones)** | Inoperable without active internet |
| Account Requirement | **Zero account, zero sign-in** | Mandatory email, account, and billing profile |

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Studio & Trust Questions
- **Q: How can I verify that HANNCREST apps send 0 KB of data?**
  - A: You can independently verify network traffic using macOS packet inspection tools like Little Snitch, LuLu, or Wireshark. After initial local model download (for Aura and WhisperType), all apps operate completely locally with 0 KB outbound traffic.
- **Q: Are HANNCREST apps subscription-based?**
  - A: No. All HANNCREST apps are sold as perpetual one-time purchases. There are no recurring monthly or annual fees.
- **Q: Do HANNCREST apps require creating an account?**
  - A: No. None of our apps require accounts, email sign-ups, or passwords.
- **Q: Are HANNCREST apps available on the Mac App Store?**
  - A: Apps are offered both via direct download from hanncrest.com and via the Mac App Store. Direct download builds include deep hardware features (like VRAM reclaim and low-level kernel diagnostics) that App Store sandboxing restricts.

### Vitals FAQ
- **Q: What is the difference between Vitals Free and Vitals Pro?**
  - A: Vitals Free provides essential real-time CPU, GPU, unified memory, disk usage, and temperature monitoring in the menu bar. Vitals Pro ($14.99 once) unlocks per-core CPU breakdowns, Apple Silicon GPU frequency and Neural Engine metrics, battery cell health, local LLM tokens/sec tracking, one-tap VRAM reclaim, Battery Vampire detection (Tame/Freeze), Sleep Drain reports, and 30-day historical time-series logging.
- **Q: How does Vitals track local LLM inference?**
  - A: Vitals inspects local system processes for Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp runtimes, measuring live tokens-per-second generation speed and unified memory / VRAM footprint.

### Breeze FAQ
- **Q: Can Breeze accidentally delete my macOS system files?**
  - A: No. Breeze strictly observes System Integrity Protection (SIP) and never touches root system files. All user-approved cleanups move files to the macOS Trash (~/.Trash) first, allowing full restoration.
- **Q: What developer caches can Breeze clean?**
  - A: Breeze cleans Xcode DerivedData, obsolete iOS/watchOS simulator runtimes, npm node_modules caches, CocoaPods caches, Gradle caches, Docker VM remnants, and Python virtual environment bloat.

### StealthShare FAQ
- **Q: Does StealthShare record video of my screen?**
  - A: No. StealthShare never records, screenshots, or saves video frames to disk or cloud. It uses macOS ScreenCaptureKit strictly to calculate window bounds in RAM and draw local visual blur overlays over confidential apps.
- **Q: What does StealthShare hide during a call?**
  - A: It hides desktop icons, widgets, notification banners, personal wallpaper, and confidential app windows (Slack, Mail, Messages, Notes). It also features Accidental-Paste Guard to catch credentials before they are pasted into shared windows.

### Aura & WhisperType FAQ
- **Q: Can Aura and WhisperType work without internet access?**
  - A: Yes. Both apps run 100% offline. After the one-time model download, all text rewriting (via Apple MLX) and voice dictation (via OpenAI Whisper on the Apple Neural Engine) occur locally in unified RAM.
- **Q: Does WhisperType save my voice recordings?**
  - A: No. Audio captured from your microphone is buffered temporarily in RAM, processed directly on the Apple Neural Engine, and immediately discarded.
